title: Getting Started with Privacy-Preserving AI
excerpt: Exploring techniques to protect user data while leveraging the power of Large Language Models.
content:
Privacy in AI is becoming increasingly important as LLMs become more prevalent in everyday applications. In this post, I explore various techniques for privacy-preserving AI, including differential privacy, federated learning, and local inference with Small Language Models (SLMs).

## Why Privacy Matters in AI

As AI systems process more personal data, the risk of sensitive information leakage grows. Users often share personal details in prompts without realizing the implications.

## Techniques for Privacy Preservation

### 1. Local Inference
Running models locally ensures data never leaves the user's device. Tools like Ollama make this increasingly practical.

### 2. Prompt Sanitization
Automatically detecting and removing sensitive information before sending prompts to cloud-based LLMs.

### 3. Differential Privacy
Adding carefully calibrated noise to training data to prevent individual data points from being identified.

## Conclusion

Privacy-preserving AI is not just a technical challenge—it's an ethical imperative. As engineers, we must build systems that respect user privacy while delivering powerful AI capabilities.

title: Building Real-time Systems with RabbitMQ and FastAPI
excerpt: A deep dive into creating scalable real-time messaging systems using RabbitMQ with FastAPI.
content:
In modern applications, real-time communication is essential. In this post, I share my experience building a WhatsApp automation platform using RabbitMQ for message queuing and FastAPI for the backend.

## Architecture Overview

The system uses a microservices architecture where each service communicates through RabbitMQ message queues. FastAPI serves as the API gateway, handling incoming webhook events.

## Key Components

### Message Queue Design
RabbitMQ provides reliable message delivery with support for various exchange types. We used topic exchanges for routing messages to appropriate service handlers.

### Async Processing
FastAPI's async capabilities combined with RabbitMQ's non-blocking message consumption create a highly responsive system.

## Results

The system handles thousands of messages per minute with sub-second response times, demonstrating the power of event-driven architecture.
